Operation: Deploy a target subdued event you govern. Deploying the event does not count against your House Interval limit. X equals the event's deployment cost less the number of deferment tokens currently assigned to it.

name: Wake Shot, Stimulant Injector
Operation: Limit 1. Assign to a target physician. When engaging the physician to assign deferment tokens to a subdued persona, assign 2 additional deferment tokens.

name: War of Assassins
Operation: Duration Effect. Name a target rival. You and the target rival must discard all participants vanquished during intrigue rites either of you initiate.

name: Water Despot, Appropriations Director
Operation: Assign to a target ally. During petitions targeting Dune fiefs, you may increase the bid as if you had five additional solaris in your treasury. If you are the victor and cannot pay the final deployment cost, you may subdue the assigned noble instead of reducing your favor.

name: Water Marshall, Conservation Official
Operation: Engage to increase your favor by X. X equals the Water Marshal's command.

name: Water Peddler, Street Merchant
Operation: Engage to transfer up to X solaris from a target rival's treasury to your own treasury. X equals the Water Peddler's command.

name: Water Shortage
Operation: Engage up to X target Dune fiefs except deserts.

name: Water Tribute, Custom of the Fai
Operation: Pay 2X solaris to increase your favor by X. X  may not exceed 3.

name: Weirding Embassy
Operation: Assign to a target persona or charter. Arbitration Tactic (engagement). If target participates in an arbitration rite, engage to include as a participant.

name: Whale Fur Industries
Operation: Engage to produce 2 solaris in your treasury.

name: Wormsign
Operation: Discard a target subdued Sandworm event you govern to produce X solaris in your treasury. X equals the number of deferment tokens assigned to the event.

name: Zenzi Bewt, Niece of Lingar Bewt
Operation: Declaration Tactic. Engage to engage target ally.
